title: Defer transient kubelet resize errors without caching infeasibility
answers: Why does VPA stop applying higher recommendations until the Updater restarts?
How should VPA InPlace handle a kubelet ResizeError?
When should an in-place resize be deferred versus marked infeasible?
body:
Symptom: After a transient kubelet resize error, VPA skips later higher resource recommendations until the Updater restarts.
Root cause: vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/updater/restriction/pods_inplace_restriction.go:PodsInPlaceRestrictionImpl.CanInPlaceUpdate classified ResizeStatusError as InPlaceInfeasible, caching the failed recommendation; retries required a later recommendation with a lower resource.
Fix pattern: Map ResizeStatusError to InPlaceDeferred so the next loop can retry without recording permanent infeasibility.
Constraints: Applies to transient kubelet resize errors in InPlace mode; preserve InPlaceInfeasible for true capacity infeasibility (ResizeInfeasible).
applies: VPA Updater InPlace resize-status decisions and their effect on recommendation retries.
